name: Andrej Karpathy Skills
description: Upstream Karpathy coding principles for any task: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes, and goal-driven execution. Applies to writing, fixing, refactoring, reviewing and debugging code; ML prototyping is optional.
capabilities: think before coding: surface assumptions and tradeoffs
simplicity first: minimum code that solves the task
surgical changes: touch only what the request requires
goal-driven execution: define verifiable success criteria
minimal code review: identify and delete over-engineering
integration_notes: Keempat prinsip upstream juga diekspos di consolidated-system-prompt.txt dan .cursorrules agar berlaku tanpa menyebut nama plugin. Tidak ada MCP atau dependency numerik yang wajib.
